Plugin.Name: MD12xx Fan Control
Plugin.Overview: Beta local fan control for Dell PowerVault MD1200 and experimental MD1220 shelves with guarded discovery, automatic disk mapping, RPM-proven commissioning, independent SES telemetry, and local controller supervision. Requires an active EMM serial console, persistent serial adapter path, SES access through sg_ses, and no competing fan writer. No automatic uploads or cloud services. AI-assisted development by OpenAI Codex under project-owner direction, hardware validation, and release approval.
Plugin.Requires: Unraid 7.3.2 or newer; Dell PowerVault MD1200 (verified) or MD1220 (experimental); compatible SAS HBA/controller exposing an SES /dev/sg device; sg_ses; active EMM serial access through a persistent /dev/serial/by-id path. The tested MD1200 path uses a Dell-compatible six-pin service/password-reset cable and FTDI USB-to-serial adapter. No competing fan writer. MD1400, MD1420, and other shelves are unsupported.
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: Dell PowerVault MD1200 MD1220 JBOD disk shelf fan cooling SES BlueDress FTDI HBA EMM
